notes.title: Trial version Ver1.14 released, English publisher released, tips function added
notes.content:
Hello, this is Shierin from Hyoukan Studio!

This is an announcement about the update to the trial version we previously announced.
The latest trial version is Ver1.14. If the version name does not appear on the title screen, please update or reinstall the game.

...In fact, we were adding an achievement feature for the update.
Because of this, we received contact about bug reports during the development period, and secretly released a version that was in development.
New users who started playing the game after January 24th are already playing a build equivalent to Ver. 1.14.

The update contents are listed below.

[list]
[*] Add scenario
In the version before January 23rd, it was possible to play up to partway through Chapter 2.
However, with this update we will be releasing all of Chapter 2 and one bad ending.
This will allow you to experience the unique features of Knight Case Files.

[*] We recommend you replay the demo!

[*] Improved graphics
The standing portrait graphics of some characters have been revised.
Background graphics have been added.

[*] english translation
English was not implemented in the trial version, but it has been added in this update!
Due to development reasons, some parts are machine translated. This will be corrected in the final version.

[*] Add achievements
Added achievements that can be unlocked in the trial version.
[/list]

Knight Case Files is an indie visual novel game planned and produced by Hyoukan Opera, a team of Japanese scenario writers and illustrators.

With the help of Kaguya Project's English publishing, I am now working on my long-awaited English version! If you find any strange English, please let me know and I will correct it.

For more information about the Kaguya Project, please click here.
[url=https://www.kaguyaproject.com/]https://www.kaguyaproject.com/[/url]

Let me explain why I wanted to release an English version this time.

It's because I thought, "Maybe overseas users would like our work too."

As a scenario writer, I have experience writing game scenarios (Japanese originals translated into other languages) for overseas publishers, and I have also worked on multilingual translated novel games. Thankfully, the scenarios I created were well-received, and I even received requests for additional work.

While I was receiving praise for the work I was writing, I had a feeling that "Japanese traditional works are popular (*refers to works that are not influenced by trends, not trendy works)" and "In today's Japan, there is a demand for works that companies have stopped making due to cost constraints and trends."

This may have been the case then and it may be that it's still the case now, but I'm not the kind of scriptwriter who can jump on the bandwagon and write on impulse (my writing speed is normal, so the trend will die out by then), so I find it difficult to survive in the commercial world.

...If that's the case, I thought it would be best to make it well and have people evaluate it, so I decided to make a game out of the Knight Case Files series, which is one of the masterpieces of my creative career.

So I started looking for a way to translate it into English and promote it. That's when I came across Kaguya Project.

Knight Case Files is one of the signature works of scenario writer and novelist Kouki Shiwasu (Shierin). I am pleased to have the opportunity to spread it to a wider audience through the translation of the game.

I'm a writer who specializes in dark, serious, emotionally charged, and obsessive works like "Knight Case Files," and refreshing teen romantic comedies like "Koi Moyou." 

I believe in the words of Kaguya Project and those who gave me feedback at game exhibitions, and I will not erase the style and attention to detail that I have received praise for, but will continue to brush up on the text until the very last minute of the writing period before releasing the game. 

Please support me! 
Your feedback and support give me encouragement!

notes.title: Trial version update notice
notes.content:
Good evening, Ice Cap Opera Team!

By February 2025, we will update the trial version to provide an experience closer to the retail version.
Also, regarding the development studio, we will change the notation here.

Old: Hyoukan Opera
New: Hyoukan Studio

``Planning: Hyoukan Opera'' and ``Producing: Hyoukan Studio.''

To be precise, I am in charge of "planning" for Hyoukan Opera, so I will correct the description.
The development staff has not changed. The number of people helping with development has increased.ːsteamthumbsupː

[list]
[*] Add scenario
In the current version, it was possible to play up to the middle of the second chapter.
However, with this update, we will be releasing all two chapters and one bad ending.
This allows you to experience the unique features of Knight Case Files.

[b]We recommend replaying the trial version![/b]

[*] Improved graphics
The graphics of some characters have been revised.
Added background graphics.

[*] English translation
English was not implemented in the trial version, but it will be added in a later update!
For development reasons, some parts are machine translated. This will be fixed in the production version.

[*] Add achievements
Added achievements that can be unlocked in the trial version.

[/list]

Sorry for not being able to update the notice!
A lot of things happened while I was issuing this notice.

[olist]
[*] Developer pregnancy and childbirth
This is the main cause!
I was in the middle of development towards my release goal, but work stopped due to poor health due to morning sickness.
It took more than half a year to restart, and after giving birth, it was very difficult to take care of the child.
As soon as the trial version update is completed, I will return to writing the game scenario.

[*] Additional implementation of Tips function
Knight Case Files has a very elaborate worldview, and there are over 10 characters, including some who only have names.
We implemented this to allow players to immerse themselves in the story. This required development funds...
[/olist]

There are other big announcements, but we will let you know as soon as they are available.
Please wait for the update!
